blocks.p: interface = contrat. Toutes les methodes sont publiques.

blocks.code:
<?php
interface Sortable {
    public function sortBy(string $field): array;
}

interface Filterable {
    public function filterBy(callable $cb): array;
}

class Collection implements Sortable, Filterable {
    public function __construct(private array $items) {}

    public function sortBy(string $f): array {
        usort($this->items, fn($a,$b)=>$a[$f]<=>$b[$f]);
        return $this->items;
    }

    public function filterBy(callable $cb): array {
        return array_filter($this->items, $cb);
    }
}

blocks.tip: Une classe peut implementer plusieurs interfaces = equivalent multi-inheritance.

quiz.expl: Une interface declare un contrat public.
